text:
maria_support: Hey team — customer reported embeddings coming back with different vector sizes depending on which pool handles the request. Hosted returns 1536, Dedicated returns 512. Happening intermittently during high throughput. Repro steps below. Pls advise.

eli_oncall: Can you paste a minimal repro curl or SDK call? Also which model id and routing policy?

maria_support: Model is `open-embed-xl-v2` (catalog id: rwd/open-embed-xl-v2@1.2). Routing: smart-routing (latency-first) with burst to dedicated. Repro curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd/open-embed-xl-v2@1.2","input":["test sentence"],"batching":{"max_tokens":2048}}'
```
Observed response shapes: sometimes `{"embedding":[512 numbers]}` sometimes `{"embedding":[1536 numbers]}`.

dev_ben: Interesting — sounds like model variant mismatch or quantization fallback. Any request IDs or traces?

maria_support: Got two request_ids from customer: `req_8f3a8c` (512) and `req_8f3a9d` (1536). Customer attached raw response headers: `x-rwd-deploy: hosted/us-west-2/v2` for the 1536, `x-rwd-deploy: dedicated/eu-west-1/pool-7` for the 512.

eli_oncall: @dev_ben can you check model variant mapping for `rwd/open-embed-xl-v2@1.2` across hosted vs dedicated? Maybe dedicated uses a quantized 512 variant when load high.

dev_ben: Looking... quick note: We have a trimmed-embed-512 quantized artefact used for low-memory dedicated pools. It should be ABI-compatible but not dimensionally different. If dims differ that's a packaging bug.

maria_support: Customer also shared timing: errors/shape mismatch spikes when QPS>1200 and batching latency increases. When they routed all traffic to hosted, parity fixed.

infra_bot: [autoscaler] Pool "dedicated/eu-west-1/pool-7" scaled from 4 -> 1 instances at 2024-11-27T15:02:11Z due to commit-policy.

eli_oncall: That autoscaler downscale during burst could have swapped to a fallback binary. @dev_ben any recent rollout that touches embedding artifacts/loader?

dev_ben: We rolled kernel/loader rev a47 last week for memory improvement. It included an optimization that selects a smaller shard when instance memory < threshold. I need to confirm it doesn't change output shape.

maria_support: Customer wants triage steps and mitigation. They are sensitive to billing because mismatched dims break downstream indexing and cause duplicates.

eli_oncall: Immediate mitigation: disable smart-routing for the tenant and pin routing to hosted. @customer_ops can you apply a tenant override?

customer_ops: Doing now — switching tenant `acct_92q` to `route: hosted-only` and increasing quota to soak. Will update in ~2m.

maria_support: Customer confirmed now all embeddings 1536 after routing flip. They still want root cause.

dev_ben: Next steps I’ll: 1) grep release a47 for artifact selection logic, 2) repro locally by simulating low-memory dedicated instance with same binary, 3) compare binary hashes and model loader logs.

eli_oncall: Also get the kernel logs for `req_8f3a8c` and `req_8f3a9d` (trace ids included). If loader selected "trimmed-embed-512" it should have logged `EMBED_SHARD=512`.

maria_support: attaching customer log excerpt: 
```
x-rwd-trace: trace-8f3a8c
loader: artifact=trimmed-embed-512 version=2024-11-25 mem_available=1.2GiB
inference: tokens=7 latency=42ms
```
and for the 1536 case: 
```
x-rwd-trace: trace-8f3a9d
loader: artifact=open-embed-xl-v2 full weight version=1.2 mem_available=4.8GiB
inference: tokens=7 latency=18ms
```

dev_ben: That log strongly suggests the dedicated pool picked a smaller artifact. That shouldn't happen for pinned model version. Possible causes: artifact lookup fallback when disk cache corrupted or automatic artifact substitution when instance memory below threshold.

eli_oncall: Can we confirm cache integrity on `pool-7` nodes and whether rollout a47 changed fallback ACLs?

dev_ben: I'll run `rwd-artifact-check --pool pool-7 --model rwd/open-embed-xl-v2@1.2` and post results.

maria_support: Customer wants a formal repro they can run to validate after we patch. Suggest adding a short checklist in the thread.

dev_ben: Repro checklist (quick):
1) Create a dedicated pool with constrained mem (1.5GiB) and attach model `rwd/open-embed-xl-v2@1.2`.
2) Send steady traffic at QPS 1500 with batching enabled.
3) Watch `x-rwd-deploy` headers and `loader` logs; check for `trimmed-embed-512`.
4) Switch pool instance type to 8GiB, drain and restart; confirm embeddings flip to 1536.

eli_oncall: Add to that: capture request IDs and run `rwd-trace get <id>` to pull kernel logs.

maria_support: Thanks. Can you also estimate customer impact window so I can coordinate billing credits?

dev_ben: TBD after I verify whether it's an intentional fallback or bug. If it's bug, we should offer 2 weeks credit for affected tokens.

infra_bot: [deploy-bot] Rollout a47 detected: changed `artifact_selection` heuristics. Owner: @dev_ben.

eli_oncall: @dev_ben prioritize a hotfix to ensure artifact selection never changes embedding dims. If safe, push config rollback for the heuristic and redeploy pool-7 cache.

dev_ben: Will do. Starting with local repro now, I'll post logs + PR link.

maria_support: I'll keep customer on the loop. Sending them the workaround + repro checklist now. :thumbsup:

customer_ops: Tenant override confirmed. Customer reporting normal behavior.

eli_oncall: Thanks team. Please update this thread with final RCA and PR/CL references so support can close ticket.
